# Fixtures

- `oms/2026-01/` — excerpts of a few dozen lines from the real `mapping.zip` and
  `SimpleTabulation-ICD-11-MMS-pt.zip` files, in their literal format (tab, CRLF), for tests
  without network. Copied from the `cid-ponte` repository (`fixtures/oms/`), where they are
  generated by `scripts/make_fixtures.py`. They are not the tables; the app downloads the full
  files from WHO at run time.
- `golden-2026-01.json` — the answers cid-ponte (Python) gives over those excerpts, with the
  field names of this project's TypeScript contract. The bridge must reproduce it exactly.
